protocol: Explicit algorithm change, not a relabeling of the prior linear screens: use finite float32 GMRES outputs as approximate search directions, accepting them only through the existing eight-size Armijo1e-4 nonlinear merit check. The original1e-6/1e-12 linear screen remains recorded and may fail; no claim of an accurate linear inverse. This revises the earlier conservative rule that every linear diagnostic must pass before nonlinear use. Rationale: all action screens passed while many linear errors exceed the strict threshold; actual nonlinear merit and unchanged endpoint gates test whether these approximate directions are usable. No increased Krylov/continuation budget or tolerance change. Same lambda schedule,16Newton steps/stage,both cold/capped starts; terminate on action cap, nonfinite output or failed Armijo. Original final natural/feasibility1e-8,primal1e-9,wave1e-5 and lambda0 required. Nonlinear residual/state and preconditioner setup remain float64; directions and actions float32. Not full float32 GPU solver.

sources.run.py:
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
setup=(p.parent/'rain-continuation-float32/run.py').read_text().rsplit("source=(p.parent/'rain-projected-continuation/run.py')",1)[0]
setup=setup.replace("print('FLOAT32',audit32[-1],flush=True)","print('FLOAT32',audit32[-1],flush=True);return x.astype(float) if residual is not None and np.all(np.isfinite(x)) else None")
setup=setup.replace('audit32.append(dict(lam=lam,','audit32.append(dict(arm=name,lam=lam,')
exec(compile(setup,str(p/'direction.py'),'exec'))
source=(p.parent/'rain-projected-continuation/run.py').read_text()
old="D=r.residual(y,True)+lam*r.E;delta,_,rank,_=np.linalg.lstsq(D,-F,rcond=1e-12);accepted=False"
new="""D=r.residual(y,True)+lam*r.E;delta=check32(y,lam,F,D);rank=-1;accepted=False
   if delta is None:termination='invalid-direction-or-action-cap';break"""
assert old in source;source=source.replace(old,new).split("if not all(v['status']=='reference-pass'")[0]
exec(compile(source,str(p/'nonlinear.py'),'exec'))
(p/'direction-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(records=audit32,linear_failures=sum(not v['linear_pass'] for v in audit32)),indent=2))
if not all(v['status']=='reference-pass' for v in results.values()):raise SystemExit(1)
